records.title: Labor Day Closures
records.description: City Hall Offices, Library, & Restricted Use Site will be closed on Monday, September 7, 2025. Trash collection will be moved to Tuesday.

records.title: Traffic Notice – Signal Outage
records.description: The stop light at North Ave & Hillsview Rd is currently out due to damage from high winds. The signal will be changed to a flashing red light in all directions. Please treat the intersection as a three-way stop until repairs can be made.

records.title: Icy Roads Update
records.description: Street Crews have been out since 4:00am salting roads, focusing mostly on intersections and inclines. We will continue to monitor roads and respond to slick conditions as necessary throughout the day.

records.title: Forecasted Weather Conditions
records.description: Staff will be monitoring the forecasted weather conditions. Snow removal crews will be dispatched in the morning hours and as needed throughout the day.

records.title: Weather & Snow Removal Update
records.description: Staff will continue to monitor weather conditions overnight & be dispatched in the morning as needed. On Friday, crews will finish clean up of cul-de-sacs and dead-end streets. Use caution & allow crews space to safely perform their work. Thank you!

records.title: Weather & Roads
records.description: Staff are monitoring weather and road conditions. If warranted, snow removal crews will be dispatched as early as 4:00 AM Wednesday. Operations will focus on Priority 1 and Priority 2 routes to ensure main travel corridors are cleared.

records.title: Snow Removal Subscription Service
records.description: Applications for the Snow Removal Subscription Service are now available. Stop by City Hall or call Public Works at 605-642-1333 to learn more about the program and get an application. The City is pleased to announce a snow removal subscription service designed to assist residents with the removal of snow windrows left in front of driveways following plowing operations. records.title: Juneteenth Closure
records.description: City Hall Offices, Library, & Restricted Use Site will be closed on Friday June 19, 2026. There will be no changes to garbage collection.

records.title: New sign installations at Spearfish Mountain View and West Elementary Schools
records.description: New street signs are being installed to improve school zone safety around West Elementary and Mountain View Elementary Schools.

records.title: Downtown Street Closure
records.description: Temporary Main Street closure from Jackson Blvd to Grant St beginning on September 28, 2026.
